cards.card_text: Then Elihu says a man is also chastened on his bed.
cards.verse_text: A man is also chastened on his bed with pain and constant distress in his bones,
cards.snippet: A man is also chastened on his bed with pain and constant distress in his bones,

cards.card_text: Then the prophecy says, “I will chasten them when I please…” Not on Israel's schedule, friend.
cards.verse_text: I will chasten them when I please; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bondage for their double transgression.
